R. Hansen* Date Written: 08-24-93* Oracle Vers. Orig.: 7.0* Forms Vers. Orig.: 3.0* Revision History:** Modified By Modified Date Version Description of changes* ---------------------------------------------------------------* M. R. Hansen 08-24-93 0.0 Initial Version* " 06-21-94 1.0 See AR 59009* " 06-21-94 1.0 See AR 59011* " 06-21-94 1.0 See AR 59012* " 06-21-94 1.0 See AR 59013* Linh Tran 03-10-95 1.1 Added online help** Abstract:* This form allows an operator to allocate products to an order for* the Serve*Care system.** Menu Reference:* Order Processing Functions, Order Allocation.** Error Conditions:* '0000' - transaction committed* '0200' - Invalid function key* '0306' - Invalid order number* '0600' - unsuccessful commit* '2301' - Enter 'Y' and 'N' and press [Nxtfld]* '2401' - Nothing to commit* '2701' - All units requested have been allocated* '2702' - Enter 'X' and Press [MENU] to allocate* '2703' - No Units have been allocated to this order* '2704' - Enough units have been allocated to this item* '2705' - Enter 'X' and Press [Menu] to allocate this unit* '2706' - No units available to allocate** Inputs:* Order Number** Outputs:* Pick Slip ID - Screen* Pick Slip Report - Printout** Modules Referenced:* handle_error - SRVLIB* check_package_failure - SRVLIB* post_transaction - SRVLIB* commit_transaction - SRVLIB** Assumptions and Limitations:* None.** Functional Descriptions:** 1. Operator enters an Order Number, either by selecting it from a* list of values or by entering it in the field. Header information* is displayed. Each order item is also displayed.** 2. Next the operator selects a line item to allocate by placing an X* next to the line item to allocate. The Operator can select one* or more order items to allocate at a time. To globally select all* allocatable line items press the [ENTQRY] key.** 3. To proceed with the allocation after all the line items to be* processed have selected, the operator presses the [MENU] key.** 4. The operator then selects the products to allocate to the* particular line item. This is done also by either placing an 'X'* by each product or press [ENTQRY] to select enough products to* fill the line item.** 5. After all the chosen line items have been allocated the operator* may press the [EXIT] key to cancel all allocation to order* and exit from the form. Otherwise to save the allocation and* create a pick slip press [COMMIT].****************************************************************************

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_user VARCHAR2(50);
 v_local_time date;
begin
begin
 select order_no into :order_no from pick_slips where
 pick_slip_id in (select pick_slip_id from pick_slip_products
 where
 box_id=:box_id and
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and product_status = 'PK')
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when no_data_found then 
 null;
 when others then 
 null;
 
end;
 begin
 select order_class, consignee_id,est_arrival_time
 into :order_class,:consignee_id,:est_arrival_time
 from orders
 where order_no = :order_no
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id; /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 
 -- time zone change --03/04/11--sandip
 if Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(:ready_boxes.est_arrival_time,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 :ready_boxes.est_arrival_time := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');
 end if; 
 
 exception
 when no_data_found then null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select class_desc
 into :s_priority
 from vserv_order_classes
 where order_class = :order_class
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when no_data_found then null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select name
 into :s_consignee_id
 from consignee
 where consignee_id = :consignee_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when no_data_found then null; 
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
/*
 begin
 select box_type, packed_by
 into :box_type,:packed_by
 from boxes
 where box_id = :box_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :box_type := null;
 :packed_by := null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
*/
 begin
 select code_desc
 into :s_box_type
 from vserv_box_types
 where code = :box_type;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_box_type := null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select user_first_name
 into :s_user_name
 from vserv_users
 where user_id = :packed_by;
 temp_user := :s_user_name;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_user_name := null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select user_last_name
 into :s_user_name
 from vserv_users
 where user_id = :packed_by;
 temp_user := temp_user || ' ' || :s_user_name;
 :s_user_name := temp_user;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_user_name := null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 -- time zone change --03/04/11--sandip
 if Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(:ready_boxes.closed_date,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 :ready_boxes.s_closed_date := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');
 end if; 

end;
